name: orbital-sentinel
description: ORBITAL SENTINEL — mission console for a 6U hyperspectral CubeSat monitoring UAE coastal waters. One closed orbit in 90 s with a continuous time warp, synthesised mission audio, live AOS/LOS and a water-security readout. Static site for GitHub Pages, plus the Node + Python backend it was ported from.

scripts.check: node tools/sync-map3d.mjs --check && npm run reference && npm run parity && npm run site-check
